new.instrument: FDA warning letter, Kimera Labs Inc.
new.summary: FDA construed the secreted-or-extracted-human-products exclusion in 21 CFR 1271.3(d) as placing such products outside HCT/P status. Directly analogous to the SB 1768 exclusion, which borrows the same language.
